seoTitle: Lost Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Lost test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jack, Kate, Sawyer, Locke, Sayid, Hurley, Charlie or Ben — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who takes charge when everything falls apart, the one who believes it all happened for a reason, or the one quietly working an angle? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle pressure, people and bad luck, and find out which Lost survivor you are.

characters.name: Jack Shephard
characters.title: The Reluctant Leader
characters.summary: When things fall apart, everyone looks at you — and you can't stop yourself fixing it.
description: Like Jack, you're the one people turn to in a crisis. He was a spinal surgeon before Oceanic 815 went down, and within minutes of the crash he was running between the wreckage treating anyone he could reach.
You believe in facts, plans and hard work, and you struggle to trust anything you can't prove. When someone tells you everything happens for a reason, part of you wants to argue.
Your problem is letting go. You carry everyone's problems as if they're yours to solve, and you find it very hard to accept that some things can't be fixed.
characters.flaw: You need to fix everything, and it wears you down.
characters.signature: Taking charge in the middle of chaos while quietly falling apart inside.
characters.clashReason: they always need to be in charge and fix everything

characters.name: Kate Austen
characters.title: The Runaway
characters.summary: You're brave, capable and quick on your feet — and when things get too close, your instinct is to run.
description: Like Kate, you can handle yourself. She was a fugitive being escorted by a US marshal when Oceanic 815 crashed — and she was the one who stitched Jack's wound on the beach.
You're good at tracking, climbing and getting yourself out of trouble. You don't like being told to stay behind, and you'll volunteer for the dangerous job before anyone else.
But you keep your past locked away, and when feelings get complicated you'd rather keep moving than face them. Being torn between two people? Very familiar.
characters.flaw: When things get hard, you run — from places and from feelings.
characters.signature: Heading into the jungle first, then disappearing before anyone can ask questions.
characters.clashReason: they'll disappear the moment things get serious

characters.name: Sawyer
characters.title: The Charming Cynic
characters.summary: You act like you only look out for yourself. Nobody who knows you actually believes that.
description: Like Sawyer, you've got a sharp tongue and a nickname for everyone. His real name is James Ford — he took the name 'Sawyer' from the con man who ruined his family, then became a con man himself.
You'd rather lie in a hammock with a paperback than join a group meeting, and you put up a tough, selfish front so nobody gets too close.
Underneath, you're loyal and surprisingly soft. When it really matters, you're the one who shows up — you'd just rather nobody made a big deal of it.
characters.flaw: You push people away before they can let you down.
characters.signature: A paperback, a pair of reading glasses and a nickname for whoever just walked in.
characters.clashReason: they'll never give you a straight answer

characters.name: John Locke
characters.title: The Believer
characters.summary: You believe things happen for a reason — and you hate being told what you can't do.
description: Like Locke, you have faith that life is heading somewhere. Before the crash he worked at a box company and used a wheelchair; when he woke up on the island, he could walk again — and he never doubted what that meant.
You're the underdog people overlook. You're good in the wilderness, patient, and far more capable than your job title suggests.
Your faith is your strength and your blind spot. Once you believe in something, nothing can shake you — even when maybe something should.
characters.flaw: Once you believe something, you won't hear anyone who disagrees.
characters.signature: A hunting knife, an orange and a quiet smile that says you know something nobody else does.
characters.clashReason: they're sure everything is destiny, and nothing you say will change their mind

characters.name: Sayid Jarrah
characters.title: The Principled Soldier
characters.summary: You're calm, capable and fiercely loyal — and you carry a past you're still trying to make up for.
description: Like Sayid, you're the person people want beside them when things go wrong. He was a communications officer in the Iraqi Republican Guard, and on the island he was the one trying to fix the radio and get a signal out.
You're thoughtful, principled and polite — but if someone threatens the people you care about, you become very direct, very fast.
There are things in your past you're not proud of, and you're honest about them. You keep trying to be a better person, even when life keeps pulling you back.
characters.flaw: You judge yourself harder than anyone else ever could.
characters.signature: Rewiring a broken radio with whatever parts you can find.
characters.clashReason: they can see straight through any excuse

characters.name: Hurley
characters.title: The Big Heart
characters.summary: You're kind, funny and honest — even if you're pretty sure the universe is out to get you.
description: Like Hurley, you're the heart of the group. Hugo Reyes won the lottery with a set of numbers — then became convinced they were cursed, because bad luck followed him everywhere.
You're the one who makes people laugh when things are grim, who shares the food, and who notices when someone's being left out.
You don't think of yourself as a hero, but when it counts you're the one people trust most — because you never pretend to be anyone but yourself.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself far more than you should.
characters.signature: Sharing the last of the food and cracking a joke while everything goes wrong.
characters.clashReason: they're so honest you can't get anything past them

characters.name: Charlie Pace
characters.title: The Rock Star with a Heart
characters.summary: You want to matter — and when you care about someone, you'd do anything for them.
description: Like Charlie, you're funny, a bit dramatic and more fragile than you let on. He was the bassist in a one-hit-wonder band called Drive Shaft, and he still can't resist mentioning it.
You've struggled with something that kept pulling you back, and you know what it's like to let people down. That makes you fight even harder to prove yourself.
When you love someone, you're fiercely protective. On the island that was Claire and her baby — and he'd have done anything for them.
characters.flaw: You need to feel important, and it can lead you into bad decisions.
characters.signature: A guitar, a half-finished song and something written on your fingers.
characters.clashReason: they need everyone's attention, and you can't always give it

characters.name: Ben Linus
characters.title: The Manipulator
characters.summary: You're calm, clever and always three moves ahead — and nobody's ever quite sure when you're telling the truth.
description: Like Ben, you prefer to win with your head. The first time the survivors met him he told them he was a balloonist called Henry Gale — it was a lie, and he was actually the leader of the Others.
You're polite, well-read and patient. You'd rather let other people do the shouting while you quietly steer things exactly where you want them.
The problem is trust. You've lied so often, to so many people, that even when you mean it, nobody believes you.
characters.flaw: You manipulate people so often you've forgotten how to just be honest.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a polite smile and a plan nobody else can see.
characters.clashReason: you'd never know when they're lying

questions.text: Your flight's cancelled and you're stuck at the airport overnight. You...

options.text: Sort out hotel rooms for everyone around you
Grab a corner and a book, and nickname everyone who annoys you
Decide it happened for a reason
Hit the food court before it closes

questions.text: Someone tells you there's no way you can do something. You...

options.text: Do it anyway, just to prove them wrong
Don't argue. Just show them
Smile, and ask what makes them so sure
Laugh — they're probably right — but try anyway

questions.text: A friend asks for help with something that's really not your problem. You...

options.text: Say no — then turn up and help anyway
Take the whole thing on. You can't not fix it
Help, and don't ask why they need it
Help — and remember they owe you one

questions.text: Things get tense and you start to feel trapped. You...

options.text: Get in the car and drive. Anywhere
Crack a joke so everyone can breathe again
Go quiet and wait until you know your next move
Stay calm and look for the way out

questions.text: There's something in your past you're not proud of. You...

options.text: Keep it to yourself. Nobody needs to know
Tell the truth if someone asks, and live with it
Make a joke about it before anyone else can
Tell yourself you're a different person now

questions.text: A long, lazy afternoon to yourself. You...

options.text: Read a paperback in a hammock. Don't bother me
Play guitar and write songs nobody's heard yet
Go hiking, well off the marked trail
Cook a huge meal and invite everyone

questions.text: Someone gives you a voucher for any course you like. You book...

options.text: Electronics. You like knowing how things work
A first-aid course. You want to be the one who can help
Something outdoors — climbing, tracking, anything but sitting still
Piano lessons. You like something that takes discipline

questions.text: You're asked to take charge of a group that's falling apart. You...

options.text: Step up, even though it'll wear you out
Say you're not a leader — then help hold everyone together anyway
Say yes, then panic that you'll let them down
Accept. Maybe this is what you were meant for

questions.text: Someone you care about is going through a really bad time. You...

options.text: Sit with them and make them laugh
Protect them, whether they want you to or not
Say something rude, then quietly bring them what they need
Show up. No questions asked

questions.text: Everything keeps going wrong for you. You think...

options.text: You're cursed. It's the only explanation
It's bad luck. It happens. Keep working
It's all leading somewhere. Trust it
Luck is for people without a plan

questions.text: Your plane has crashed on a remote island. There's fresh water and shelter inland, but rescuers would only spot you on the beach. You...

options.text: Move people inland. Water and shelter keep everyone alive
Stay on the beach and look after yourself
Head off to explore the island alone
Climb to high ground and try to get a signal out

questions.text: You're stranded on an island with a group. You catch a stranger who says he crashed here too, but his story doesn't add up. You...

options.text: Question him until the story falls apart
Play along and see what he gives away
Make sure he gets food and water. He's still a person
Stay out of it. Everyone here has a past
